chunks: As for what is in it from Bukayr ibn A'yan, I have transmitted it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Bukayr ibn A'yan.

And he was from Kufah, known by the kunyah Abu al-Jahm, from the mawali of Banu Shayban. When the death of Bukayr ibn A'yan reached al-Sadiq عليه السلام, he said: "Indeed, by Allah, Allah Mighty and Majestic has placed him between His Messenger and Amir al-Mu'minin, may Allah's blessings be upon them both."

And as for what is in it from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khath'ami, I have transmitted it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Zakariyya al-Mu'min, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khath'ami.

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام.
key_terms.الصَّادِقَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, peace be upon him.
key_terms.الْخَثْعَمِيِّ: A nisbah identifying Muhammad ibn Yahya as belonging to Khath'am.
key_terms.رَسُولِهِ: His Messenger, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
key_terms.مَوَالِي بَنِي شَيْبَانَ: Clients or affiliated non-tribal associates of Banu Shayban.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khath'ami and Bukayr ibn A'yan in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Bukayr ibn A'yan and from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khath'ami in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. It also includes a brief biographical note on Bukayr ibn A'yan and a statement from al-Sadiq عليه السلام praising his rank after death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Everything in this book that is narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Khath'ami has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Zakariyya Al-Mu'min, from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Khath'ami.
